epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized access incidents from 15% to 0%
epics.tocConstraintRef: Access control enforcement in API layer
requirements: R1: The system must enforce access control to closed strains based on the user's Moodle department and courses
R2: The system must enforce access control to analytical reports based on the user's Moodle department and courses

slices.title: Patch existing endpoints to enforce Moodle department-based access control
slices.jtbd: When implementing department-based access control for this epic, I want to restrict strain and report access based on the user's Moodle department, so that the epic's outcome of synchronized and secure access control is achieved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user logged in via Moodle SSO with a specific department and course
When they attempt to access closed strains or analytical reports
Then the system should allow or deny access based on those Moodle department and courses
Given the access control logic is implemented
When the system tests this behavior
Then the unit and integration tests must pass.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Access control enforcement in API layer
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase access control enforcement coverage from 0% to 100%

epics.title: Autonomous LMS Fallback Authentication Mechanism
epics.jtbd: When the external Moodle LMS fails, I want the system to provide an autonomous fallback mechanism, so that users can still access the archive and analytical reports.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce authentication downtime during LMS failures from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: The system must detect external Moodle LMS unreachability and provide a fallback authentication mechanism
R2: The system must allow users originally created via SSO to reset their fallback password or authenticate reliably using local credentials when SSO is down

slices.title: Implement LMS fallback mechanism using local credentials
slices.jtbd: When implementing the LMS fallback mechanism for this epic, I want to add failover logic for authentication, so that the epic's outcome of autonomous fallback is achieved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the external Moodle LMS is unreachable
When a user attempts to log in
Then the system should allow them to authenticate via an autonomous fallback mechanism using local credentials
Given the fallback logic is active
When the system tests this behavior
Then the Playwright E2E test must pass.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase fallback authentication success rate from 0% to 99%
